朝鮮總督府統計年報 1928

Chōsen Sōtokufu tōkei nenpō (Statistical Annual of the Government-General of Korea), 昭和三年 (Shōwa 3), published 1930
朝鮮總督府, 京城, 1930 (昭和五年)

All 511 numbered tables and two unnumbered sub-tables are transcribed (513 tables, about 285,000 figure cells), with the contents; the 凡例, the summary contents (目次概覽) and the colophon are not. Tables printed across both pages of a spread are joined into one; long tables were read in sections by different readers and joined. Each spread was read once by a Claude Sonnet agent from crops of a high-resolution scan, with no second reading. 355 cells could not be read and are marked [?]; 5 that a printed total fixes exactly (one unknown, every other figure read) are filled in and shown with a blue background (inferred). Printed totals were re-added; those that do not add up are kept as printed and noted, and where a digit was ambiguous only between 3 and 8 and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted. Lengths in 哩・鎖 (miles and chains) are re-added in base 80. Where the original prints a question mark (unknown figures for early years) it is kept as ?. Table 58 prints its number as 53; it is numbered 58 here as in the contents.
